source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps dawn rather than silently making it darkness and preserves unparalleled scale.
Maintains before/behind pattern and Eden comparison.
Keeps comparisons rather than identifying the creatures as literal horsemen.
Retains all three similes and the audible quality of the invasion.
Chooses pallor for the uncertain facial expression while noting darkening as alternative.
Preserves ordered movement and the repeated military comparisons.
Keeps the difficult weapon phrase as penetration despite resistance, without asserting literal invulnerability.
Preserves the four escalating locations and final thief simile.
Follows rule-over sense of mashal while noting proverbial taunt alternative; preserves architectural location.
Uses narrative past for the wayyiqtol turn without inventing an intervening repentance scene.
Keeps the restored three provisions and the reversal of public shame.
Leaves northern one unidentified and retains front/rear, two seas, and the ambiguous great deeds.
Chooses rain in agricultural context, preserving righteousness and noting teacher and first-month alternatives.
Keeps all flesh, both sexes in prophecy, and age-specific dream/vision language.
Makes enslavement explicit and preserves both sexes without adding my from a later quotation.
Preserves the three signs without assigning a modern event.
Keeps the cosmic transformations and before relationship.
Preserves both human calling and divine calling and all three name occurrences.
